name: k8s-deploy
description: Deployment rules for any starter, version 1.2.1: a Deployment and Service per in-cluster node, the gateway's nginx config, the starter contract's environment and NetworkPolicies from the architecture's connects relationships, with resource limits, liveness probes, no service-account tokens in pods and app.kubernetes.io labels (since 1.1.0), Nisshi 0.8.2, and backing services whose data is in the pod roll out one pod at a time (maxSurge 0), so two brokers never run at once. Use 1.2.1, not 1.2.0: 1.2.0's Recreate strategy cannot be applied over an existing deployment.
